recipes.name: Jaladas
recipes.description: 4 fresh jalapeno chiles stuffed with cream cheese, breaded, deep fried and served with a coriander sauce.
sustainabilityTips: Use seasonal jalapenos
Batch prep reduces oil waste

trainingSteps.title: Allergen Alert
trainingSteps.description: WARNING: Contains MILK (cream cheese) and GLUTEN (breadcrumbs). Always confirm with guests before ordering.

trainingSteps.title: Prep the jalapenos
trainingSteps.description: Slice each jalapeno lengthways and remove seeds. Fill generously with cream cheese. Press closed.

trainingSteps.title: Bread them
trainingSteps.description: Coat in flour, dip in egg wash, roll in breadcrumbs. Double crumb for extra crunch.

trainingSteps.title: Fry
trainingSteps.description: Deep fry at 180C for 3-4 minutes until golden. Drain well.

trainingSteps.title: Plate and serve
trainingSteps.description: Serve 4 per portion with coriander dipping sauce. Serve immediately - they lose crunch fast.

trainingSteps.title: Upsell tip
trainingSteps.description: Pairs with a Tejito or Classic Margarita. Suggest a cocktail pairing when taking the order.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Blanco
tequilaPairing.palate: Clean spirit cuts through the cream cheese richness

recipes.name: Guacamole
recipes.description: Freshly prepared avocado dip served with tortilla chips and pico de gallo. Made to order. Vegan.
sustainabilityTips: Avocados from Fairtrade certified farms
Made fresh to order - zero waste

trainingSteps.title: Allergen check
trainingSteps.description: Naturally vegan and gluten free.

trainingSteps.title: Select avocados
trainingSteps.description: Use ripe Hass avocados only. Press gently - should give slightly.

trainingSteps.title: Make the guacamole
trainingSteps.description: Halve and stone avocados. Mash chunky. Fold in diced onion, tomato, coriander, jalapeno and fresh lime juice.

trainingSteps.title: Taste and season
trainingSteps.description: Always taste before serving. Bright, fresh and seasoned.

trainingSteps.title: Serve immediately
trainingSteps.description: Serve in molcajete with tortilla chips. Never prep too far ahead.

trainingSteps.title: Upsell tip
trainingSteps.description: Best seller starter. Pairs perfectly with any margarita.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Blanco
tequilaPairing.palate: Clean spirit lifts the avocado

recipes.name: Nachos
recipes.description: Corn chips topped with refried beans and layers of melted cheese, pico de gallo and sliced jalapeno peppers. Add chicken or chorizo for extra protein.
sustainabilityTips: Refried beans are a low carbon protein source

trainingSteps.title: Dairy allergen
trainingSteps.description: Contains MILK from the melted cheese.

trainingSteps.title: Base layer
trainingSteps.description: Spread chips on tray. Layer refried beans. Top with Oaxaca cheese generously.

trainingSteps.title: Bake
trainingSteps.description: Bake at 200C for 6-8 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbling.

trainingSteps.title: Serve immediately
trainingSteps.description: Nachos must be served straight from the oven.

trainingSteps.title: Upsell
trainingSteps.description: Offer chicken (+3.00) or chorizo (+3.00). Most tables say yes.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Reposado
tequilaPairing.palate: Warmth complements the melted cheese

recipes.name: Queso Fundido
recipes.description: Melted chihuahua and oaxaca cheese to spoon into flour tortillas, accompanied by pico de gallo. Add chorizo or mushrooms for extra flavour.
sustainabilityTips: UK-produced cheese reduces food miles

trainingSteps.title: Allergen alert
trainingSteps.description: Contains MILK (both cheeses) and GLUTEN (flour tortillas).

trainingSteps.title: Melt
trainingSteps.description: Oven at 220C for 8-10 minutes until fully melted and slightly golden. Should be stretchy and gooey.

trainingSteps.title: Add protein if ordered
trainingSteps.description: Chorizo or mushrooms (+3.00) added on top before serving.

trainingSteps.title: Serve correctly
trainingSteps.description: Bring to table in hot skillet with warm flour tortillas and pico de gallo. Warn guests: HOT.

trainingSteps.title: Theatre
trainingSteps.description: Stretchy melted cheese is a visual. Encourage guests to dig in immediately.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Reposado
tequilaPairing.palate: Oak and agave complement the rich cheese

recipes.name: Tamales
recipes.description: 2 corn husks filled with corn maize and a choice of chicken mole, cheese with poblano peppers, pork in green sauce or black beans. Steamed until perfect.
sustainabilityTips: Batch steaming is energy efficient
Corn husks are compostable

trainingSteps.title: Allergen critical
trainingSteps.description: CHICKEN MOLE contains TREE NUTS and SESAME. CHEESE option contains MILK. Always clarify filling and flag allergens.

trainingSteps.title: Filling options
trainingSteps.description: Chicken mole / cheese with poblano / pork in green sauce / black beans (vegan).

trainingSteps.title: Check doneness
trainingSteps.description: Steam for 12-15 minutes. Masa should pull away cleanly from the husk.

trainingSteps.title: Serve in husk
trainingSteps.description: Serve 2 per portion still wrapped in corn husk. Show guests how to unwrap.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Blanco
tequilaPairing.palate: Freshness cuts through the richness of the masa

recipes.name: Flautas
recipes.description: 4 rolled corn tortillas filled with chicken or potato and cheese, deep fried then topped with shredded lettuce, tomatillo sauce, sour cream and queso fresco.
sustainabilityTips: Corn tortillas are naturally gluten free and low carbon

trainingSteps.title: Filling choice
trainingSteps.description: Chicken or potato and cheese (v)? Note on ticket.

trainingSteps.title: Roll tight
trainingSteps.description: Fill tortilla and roll tightly. Secure with toothpick before frying.

trainingSteps.title: Fry correctly
trainingSteps.description: Fry at 180C for 3-4 minutes. Drain well. Remove toothpicks before plating.

trainingSteps.title: Serve immediately
trainingSteps.description: Flautas lose crunch quickly. Do not let sit on the pass.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Blanco
tequilaPairing.palate: Cuts through the fried richness cleanly

recipes.name: Pescadillas
recipes.description: 2 corn tortillas filled with spiced flaked fish, then deep fried until golden and accompanied with a chipotle and mayonnaise sauce.
sustainabilityTips: MSC certified sustainable fish when available

trainingSteps.title: Fish allergen
trainingSteps.description: Contains FISH. Also EGGS and MUSTARD from the mayo sauce.

trainingSteps.title: The fish
trainingSteps.description: Flaked white fish seasoned with chipotle, cumin and lime. Fill corn tortilla and fold in half.

trainingSteps.title: Fry
trainingSteps.description: Fry at 180C until golden and crispy. Drain well.

trainingSteps.title: Serve with chipotle mayo
trainingSteps.description: Serve 2 per portion with chipotle mayo dipping sauce on the side.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Blanco
tequilaPairing.palate: Bright and clean - complements the fish perfectly

recipes.name: Empanadas
recipes.description: An assortment of 4 corn pastries filled with a choice of cheese, vegan tinga, cuitlacoche or courgette flower. Served with sour cream and red sauce.
sustainabilityTips: Cuitlacoche and courgette flower fillings are very low carbon

trainingSteps.title: Filling choice
trainingSteps.description: Cheese / vegan tinga / cuitlacoche / courgette flower. Confirm before ordering.

trainingSteps.title: Fry
trainingSteps.description: Fry at 180C until golden. Drain well.

trainingSteps.title: Serve
trainingSteps.description: 4 empanadas with sour cream and red sauce on the side.

recipes.name: Tostada
recipes.description: 2 crispy corn tortillas topped with refried beans, lettuce, a choice of filling (vegetarian, vegan or chicken 10.80 / beef 11.80) garnished with pico de gallo, sour cream and queso fresco.
sustainabilityTips: Vegetarian and vegan options are the lowest carbon choices

trainingSteps.title: Filling choice and price
trainingSteps.description: Vegetarian / vegan / chicken is 10.80. Beef is 11.80. Confirm and price correctly.

trainingSteps.title: Build
trainingSteps.description: Crispy tostada base, refried beans spread on top, lettuce, filling, pico de gallo, sour cream drizzle, queso fresco crumbled on top.

trainingSteps.title: Serve immediately
trainingSteps.description: Tostadas go soft quickly. Build and serve fast.

recipes.name: Panucho
recipes.description: Corn tortilla topped with refried beans, a choice of chicken pibil, vegan pibil or shredded cochinita, and marinated red onion.
sustainabilityTips: Cochinita pibil is slow-cooked pork - maximises yield from secondary cuts

trainingSteps.title: Filling choice
trainingSteps.description: Chicken pibil / vegan pibil / shredded cochinita. Confirm with guest.

trainingSteps.title: Build
trainingSteps.description: Crispy corn tortilla, refried beans spread, filling on top, marinated red onion. Simple and clean.

trainingSteps.title: Good value dish
trainingSteps.description: At 6.80 this is our most affordable starter. Great for guests who want to try something small.

recipes.name: Ceviche Verde
recipes.description: Fresh seabass or prawns ceviche in a sauce of tomatillo, coriander, avocado and jalapenos. Topped with sliced cucumber. Served with two tostadas and totopos.
sustainabilityTips: MSC certified sustainable seabass when available
Ceviche technique uses acid not heat - low energy

trainingSteps.title: Allergen critical
trainingSteps.description: Contains FISH (seabass) or CRUSTACEANS (prawns). Always confirm and flag allergens.

trainingSteps.title: Protein choice
trainingSteps.description: Confirm: seabass or prawns?

trainingSteps.title: Prep
trainingSteps.description: Dice protein. Marinate in fresh lime juice minimum 10 minutes. Add tomatillo sauce, diced avocado, coriander, jalapeno.

trainingSteps.title: Plate elegantly
trainingSteps.description: Premium dish at 18.20. Excellent presentation required. Tostadas and totopos neatly arranged.

trainingSteps.title: Serve cold
trainingSteps.description: Always served cold. Never under heat lamps.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Blanco
tequilaPairing.palate: Perfect complement to ceviche acids

recipes.name: Ceviche Rojo
recipes.description: Fresh seabass or prawns ceviche in a sauce of tomatoes, olives, and garlic, garnished with fresh coriander leaves.
sustainabilityTips: MSC certified sustainable seabass when available

trainingSteps.title: Allergen critical
trainingSteps.description: Contains FISH or CRUSTACEANS. Always confirm and flag.

trainingSteps.title: Rojo vs Verde
trainingSteps.description: Rojo has tomatoes, olives and garlic - richer and more savoury than Verde. Describe the difference when guests are choosing.

trainingSteps.title: Serve cold
trainingSteps.description: Always served cold on a chilled plate.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Blanco
tequilaPairing.palate: Brightens the rich tomato base

recipes.name: Ceviche Blanco
recipes.description: Fresh seabass or prawn ceviche marinated in lime juice with onions, green chiles, habanero and oregano.
sustainabilityTips: Simplest preparation - least energy and waste

trainingSteps.title: Allergen critical
trainingSteps.description: Contains FISH or CRUSTACEANS.

trainingSteps.title: Blanco style
trainingSteps.description: The purest ceviche. No tomato or avocado - just lime, onion, chiles and the fish. The habanero adds significant heat. Always warn guests.

trainingSteps.title: Habanero warning
trainingSteps.description: Habanero is much hotter than jalapeno. Warn the guest before ordering.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Blanco
tequilaPairing.palate: Nothing distracts from the clean ceviche flavours

recipes.name: Sopa de Tortilla
recipes.description: Seasoned fresh tomato soup with fried corn tortilla strips, accompanied with sour cream, dried chiles, queso fresco and sliced avocado.
sustainabilityTips: Uses leftover tortillas for the strips - zero waste

trainingSteps.title: Allergen check
trainingSteps.description: Contains MILK from sour cream and queso fresco. Vegan option: omit dairy toppings.

trainingSteps.title: The broth
trainingSteps.description: Roasted tomato, onion and garlic blended smooth then simmered with dried ancho chilli. Rich red and slightly smoky.

trainingSteps.title: Tortilla strips
trainingSteps.description: Fry corn tortilla strips until crispy. Add at last moment to retain crunch.

trainingSteps.title: Plate correctly
trainingSteps.description: Hot soup in warmed bowl. Add strips, sliced avocado, sour cream drizzle, crumbled queso fresco.

trainingSteps.title: Temperature
trainingSteps.description: Serve piping hot. Check temperature before sending.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Reposado
tequilaPairing.palate: Warmth mirrors the chilli in the soup

recipes.name: Caldo Xochitl
recipes.description: Chicken broth with vegetables and shredded chicken with fresh avocado, fresh coriander, chopped onion and chipotle chile on the side.
sustainabilityTips: Chicken broth made from carcasses - zero waste

trainingSteps.title: Gluten free and dairy free
trainingSteps.description: Naturally free from all major allergens. Good option for guests with multiple dietary requirements.

trainingSteps.title: The broth
trainingSteps.description: Rich chicken broth with vegetables. Shredded chicken inside. Fresh toppings: avocado, coriander, onion. Chipotle on the side.

trainingSteps.title: Serve hot
trainingSteps.description: Broth must be piping hot. Avocado goes in just before serving.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Blanco
tequilaPairing.palate: Delicate spirit matches the clean chicken broth

recipes.name: Pozole
recipes.description: A fresh whole corn soup from Guerrero, Mexico, garnished with shredded lettuce, radish, onion, avocado, chopped chile and lime quarters. Add chicken +3.00.
sustainabilityTips: Hominy corn is a traditional sustainable crop

trainingSteps.title: Garnish station
trainingSteps.description: Pozole garnished with: shredded lettuce, sliced radish, diced onion, sliced avocado, chopped chile and lime. Arrange neatly.

trainingSteps.title: Upsell add chicken
trainingSteps.description: Add chicken is +3.00. Always offer it.

trainingSteps.title: Serve hot
trainingSteps.description: Broth must be boiling hot. Garnishes go on just before service.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Blanco
tequilaPairing.palate: Light spirit lets the complex broth shine

recipes.name: Birria
recipes.description: Traditional beef broth made with spices and chillies, served with rice, coriander and onion, chopped chilli. Served with corn or flour tortillas.
sustainabilityTips: Slow-cooked secondary cuts maximise yield
Broth uses all trimmings - zero waste cooking

trainingSteps.title: Allergen note
trainingSteps.description: Corn tortillas are gluten free. Flour tortillas contain GLUTEN.

trainingSteps.title: The birria
trainingSteps.description: Rich beef broth with dried chillies and slow-cooked beef. Deep red, intensely flavoured. Never watery.

trainingSteps.title: Serve correctly
trainingSteps.description: Bowl of broth with shredded beef, rice, chopped onion, coriander, chilli. Warm tortillas on the side. Lime wedge.

trainingSteps.title: Dipping tortillas
trainingSteps.description: Authentic way: dip the tortilla in the broth, fill with beef and eat as a taco. Explain this to unfamiliar guests.

recipes.name: Los Tacos Classic
recipes.description: Pick one filling of your choice. Served with 5 x 12cm tortillas: corn or flour. Classic 23.80 / Gourmet +2.40. Fillings: Bistek, Campechano, Arrachera, Cochinita Pibil, Carnitas, Pastor, Chorizo, Nopales, Cuitlacoche, Rajas con Crema, Vegan Tinga, Vegan Pibil, Vegan Mole, Cholin, Tinga, Pollo Pibil, Pollo con Mole, Alambre.
sustainabilityTips: Corn tortillas are the lower carbon choice
Secondary cuts like carnitas and pastor maximise yield

trainingSteps.title: This is our signature
trainingSteps.description: Los Tacos is one of our most popular mains. Take the order with confidence and enthusiasm.

trainingSteps.title: Tortilla choice first
trainingSteps.description: Always ask: corn or flour? Corn is gluten free. Flour contains GLUTEN.

trainingSteps.title: Filling choice
trainingSteps.description: Classic fillings in base price. Gourmet options (Barbacoa, Rib Eye, Pulpo, Baja Shrimp, Camarones) are +2.40. Always mention this.

trainingSteps.title: All the accompaniments
trainingSteps.description: Served with jalapeno peppers, beans, pico de gallo, red sauce, green sauce, onion, coriander and sour cream.

trainingSteps.title: Allergen note
trainingSteps.description: Pollo con Mole and Vegan Mole contain PEANUTS, TREE NUTS and SESAME. Flag to guests.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Reposado
tequilaPairing.palate: Works with any filling

recipes.name: Taco Tray
recipes.description: Make your own tacos with 4 fillings, jalapeno peppers, beans, pico de gallo, red sauce, green sauce, onion, coriander and sour cream. 5 corn or flour tortillas per person. For 2 or more. Classic 23.80 per person / Gourmet +2.40.
sustainabilityTips: Sharing dishes reduce individual plate waste

trainingSteps.title: This is for groups
trainingSteps.description: Price is per person. Confirm table size when ordering.

trainingSteps.title: Confirm fillings
trainingSteps.description: Guest chooses 4 fillings per person. Gourmet fillings are +2.40 per person each.

trainingSteps.title: Presentation is theatre
trainingSteps.description: Everything laid out - tortillas, fillings in separate dishes, all accompaniments. Encourage photos.

trainingSteps.title: Explain how it works
trainingSteps.description: Tortilla, small amount of filling, top with accompaniments. Less is more - overfilled tacos fall apart.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Reposado
tequilaPairing.palate: Works with any combination of fillings

recipes.name: Molcajete Mestizo
recipes.description: The speciality of the house. Filling served in a volcanic stone bowl with cheese, chorizo, grilled spring onions, coriander and cactus. Choice of red, tomatillo or mole sauce. With 5 warm corn or flour tortillas. For 2 or more. Chicken 21.80 / Beef 23.80 / King Prawns 26.20 / Octopus 26.20 / Veg 21.80 per person.
sustainabilityTips: Cactus nopales are extremely low carbon
Volcanic stone bowls retain heat reducing energy

trainingSteps.title: This is our signature dish
trainingSteps.description: Served in a volcanic stone bowl heated in the oven. The sauce bubbles when it hits the hot stone. This is the show.

trainingSteps.title: Protein and sauce choice
trainingSteps.description: Confirm protein and price. Sauce: red / tomatillo / mole. Mole contains TREE NUTS and PEANUTS.

trainingSteps.title: The molcajete is HOT
trainingSteps.description: WARNING: Stone bowl comes directly from 250C oven. Use heat-resistant gloves. Warn the table: EXTREMELY HOT.

trainingSteps.title: The theatre moment
trainingSteps.description: Hot sauce poured into hot molcajete will sizzle and bubble. Do it confidently.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Reposado
tequilaPairing.palate: The complexity matches the rich molcajete

mezcalPairing.name: Mezcal Amores Verde
mezcalPairing.palate: Smoke is perfect with the charred proteins

recipes.name: Mole Poblano
recipes.description: Boneless chicken breast served with a traditional mole sauce made with up to 25 ingredients including chocolate, peanuts, dried chiles and topped with queso fresco ranchero. Served with rice and choice of beans, sauteed potato or vegetables.
sustainabilityTips: Mole freezes perfectly - batch cook to reduce energy
Chicken from RSPCA Assured farms

trainingSteps.title: CRITICAL ALLERGEN
trainingSteps.description: WARNING: Contains PEANUTS, TREE NUTS and SESAME from mole paste. If any guest has a nut allergy DO NOT serve. Inform manager immediately. Also contains MILK.

trainingSteps.title: What is mole
trainingSteps.description: Mole (MOH-LAY) is Mexico s most complex sauce. Up to 25 ingredients: dark chocolate, dried chillies, peanuts, sesame, spices. Tell this story when you serve it.

trainingSteps.title: The sauce
trainingSteps.description: Dilute mole paste with chicken stock ratio 1:3. Simmer 15 minutes stirring constantly. Should coat the back of a spoon.

trainingSteps.title: The chicken
trainingSteps.description: Pan-seared chicken breast cooked to 75C core. Slice and arrange on plate then spoon mole generously over.

trainingSteps.title: Plate correctly
trainingSteps.description: Chicken and mole in centre. Rice and beans on the side. Crumble queso fresco ranchero on top. Scatter sesame seeds. Warm tortillas on the side.

trainingSteps.title: Ultimate pairing
trainingSteps.description: THE dish to pair with premium tequilas and mezcal. Suggest Cazcabel Reposado or Mezcal Amores.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Reposado
tequilaPairing.palate: Rich and smooth - matches the mole complexity perfectly

mezcalPairing.name: Mezcal Amores Verde
mezcalPairing.palate: Smoke echoes the chilli complexity in the mole

winePairing.name: Malbec
winePairing.palate: Tannins complement the richness of the mole

recipes.name: Mixiote de Cordero
recipes.description: Lamb shank marinated in Mexican spices, wrapped in a banana leaf and steamed until tender. An ancient Mexican cooking technique. Served with rice and choice of side.
sustainabilityTips: Lamb shank is a secondary cut - reduces food waste
Banana leaf wrapping is biodegradable

trainingSteps.title: This is premium
trainingSteps.description: At 36.80 this represents ancient Mexican culinary tradition. Every detail must be perfect.

trainingSteps.title: The technique
trainingSteps.description: Mixiote: marinated meat wrapped in banana leaf and steamed for 4-5 hours. The leaf infuses earthy flavour.

trainingSteps.title: The reveal
trainingSteps.description: Bring banana leaf parcel to the table. Open it tableside in front of the guest. This is drama.

trainingSteps.title: The lamb
trainingSteps.description: The shank should fall off the bone at a touch. If not tender, do not serve it.

trainingSteps.title: Pairing recommendation
trainingSteps.description: Recommend Cazcabel Reposado at minimum. If celebrating, suggest a Don Julio or Fortaleza tequila flight.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Reposado
tequilaPairing.palate: Oak aging complements the slow-cooked lamb beautifully

recipes.name: Crepas de Flor de Calabaza
recipes.description: Crepes filled with courgette flowers, sweetcorn, diced courgette and onion, in our chef s special red sauce. Topped with a cheese gratin. Vegetarian.
sustainabilityTips: Courgette flowers are a seasonal ingredient - support local growers
Vegetarian dish - significantly lower carbon than meat mains

trainingSteps.title: Allergens
trainingSteps.description: Contains MILK (cheese gratin), GLUTEN and EGGS (crepes).

trainingSteps.title: What are courgette flowers
trainingSteps.description: The flower of the courgette plant. Delicate, seasonal and beautiful. This is a signature vegetarian main. Tell this story to guests.

trainingSteps.title: Build
trainingSteps.description: Fill crepes with courgette flower, sweetcorn and courgette mixture. Roll and place in oven dish. Cover with red sauce and Oaxaca cheese. Gratinate until bubbling.

trainingSteps.title: Serve immediately
trainingSteps.description: Crepes do not hold well. Serve as soon as they come from the oven.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Blanco
tequilaPairing.palate: Light clean tequila complements the delicate vegetable filling

recipes.name: Crepas de Cuitlacoche
recipes.description: Crepes filled with black corn mushrooms, sauteed with onion, garlic, button mushrooms, serrano chile and sweet corn in a special Chef s white cheese sauce.
sustainabilityTips: Cuitlacoche grows on corn - considered waste by some farmers, delicacy by us
Vegetarian dish - significantly lower carbon than meat mains

trainingSteps.title: Allergens
trainingSteps.description: Contains MILK (white cheese sauce), GLUTEN and EGGS (crepes).

trainingSteps.title: What is cuitlacoche
trainingSteps.description: Cuitlacoche (Mexican truffle) is a fungus that grows on corn. Earthy, smoky, mushroom-like. A delicacy in Mexico. Tell this story.

trainingSteps.title: Build
trainingSteps.description: Saute cuitlacoche with onion, garlic and mushrooms until dark and fragrant. Fill crepes. Cover with white cheese sauce. Bake until bubbling.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Reposado
tequilaPairing.palate: Warm notes complement the cuitlacoche earthiness

recipes.name: Chile Relleno
recipes.description: Poblano pepper stuffed with picadillo (minced beef) at 21.20 or Oaxaca cheese at 18.80, lightly battered and sauteed in a tomato broth. Served with rice and choice of side.
sustainabilityTips: Cheese option is lower carbon than beef option

trainingSteps.title: Filling choice and price
trainingSteps.description: Picadillo (beef) is 21.20. Oaxaca cheese is 18.80 and contains MILK. Batter contains GLUTEN and EGGS.

trainingSteps.title: The poblano
trainingSteps.description: Char the poblano directly on the flame until skin blackens all over. Place in a bag to steam - skin slides off easily.

trainingSteps.title: Stuff carefully
trainingSteps.description: Make a clean incision and remove seeds. Fill with chosen filling.

trainingSteps.title: Batter and cook
trainingSteps.description: Dip stuffed pepper in batter. Fry until golden. Finish in tomato broth 3-4 minutes.

trainingSteps.title: Plate
trainingSteps.description: Chile relleno in centre, sauce around. Rice on side. Garnish with coriander and queso fresco.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Blanco
tequilaPairing.palate: Bright and clean - lets the chile character shine

recipes.name: Enchiladas de Mole

sustainabilityTips: Vegan protein option is the lowest carbon choice

trainingSteps.title: CRITICAL ALLERGEN
trainingSteps.description: PEANUTS, TREE NUTS and SESAME in the mole. Cannot be made nut-free. Also contains MILK.

trainingSteps.title: Filling choice
trainingSteps.description: Chicken / potato and cheese / vegan protein / vegetables. Note clearly on ticket.

trainingSteps.title: Build enchiladas
trainingSteps.description: Pass each tortilla through warm mole to soften. Fill, roll tightly, lay seam-down. Pour mole generously over top.

trainingSteps.title: Finish and plate
trainingSteps.description: Bake 200C for 8 minutes. Add sour cream drizzle and queso fresco. Serve with rice and beans.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Reposado
tequilaPairing.palate: Smooth tequila pairs with the rich mole

recipes.name: Enchiladas Verdes or Rojas
recipes.description: Two rolled corn tortillas stuffed with chicken, potato and cheese, vegan protein or vegetables. Topped in red or green tomatillo sauce, garnished with sour cream and queso fresco ranchero.
sustainabilityTips: Tomatillo sauce made from fresh produce daily

trainingSteps.title: Sauce choice
trainingSteps.description: Verdes (green tomatillo - tangy and fresh) or Rojas (red tomato - smoky and warming)?

trainingSteps.title: Filling choice
trainingSteps.description: Chicken / potato and cheese / vegan protein / vegetables.

trainingSteps.title: Build
trainingSteps.description: Soften tortillas in sauce, fill, roll seam-down, cover with sauce. Bake 8-10 minutes.

trainingSteps.title: Serve
trainingSteps.description: Sour cream drizzle, queso fresco ranchero on top. Rice and side. Coriander garnish.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Blanco
tequilaPairing.palate: Bright agave complements the tomatillo sauce

recipes.name: Enchiladas Cancun

trainingSteps.title: What is Cancun sauce
trainingSteps.description: A Mayan sauce made with achiote paste, orange juice and tomato. Red-orange, slightly sweet and earthy. Very different from mole or tomatillo.

trainingSteps.title: Filling choice
trainingSteps.description: Pork / chicken / potato and cheese (d) / vegan protein / vegetables.

trainingSteps.title: Build
trainingSteps.description: Same technique as all enchiladas - soften, fill, roll, sauce, bake.

tequilaPairing.name: Cazcabel Blanco
tequilaPairing.palate: The orange notes in the achiote sauce echo the tequila

recipes.name: Camarones en Salsa

recipes.name: Classic Margarita

trainingSteps.description: The Classic Margarita represents everything Mestizo stands for. Make it perfectly in under 60 seconds at peak service.

trainingSteps.description: 2:1:1 - 50ml Cazcabel Reposado, 25ml Triple Sec, 25ml fresh lime juice. Never deviate. Never free pour.

trainingSteps.title: Salt rim
trainingSteps.description: Run lime wedge around rim. Dip in chilli-salt mix. Half rim only.

trainingSteps.title: Shake hard
trainingSteps.description: Shake with ice for 12 seconds. Ice cold and slightly diluted. Strain over fresh ice.

trainingSteps.title: Garnish
trainingSteps.description: Lime wheel or wedge on the rim. Simple. Clean. Perfect.

trainingSteps.title: Speed matters
trainingSteps.description: Prep lime juice in batches. Have ice ready. Mise en place is everything behind the bar.

trainingSteps.title: The upgrade
trainingSteps.description: Grand Marnier replaces Triple Sec. Richer and more complex. For 1.00 more it is a better drink and better margin.

trainingSteps.title: Build
trainingSteps.description: Same technique as Classic. Grand Marnier instead of Triple Sec, add agave syrup for balance.

trainingSteps.title: Upsell

recipes.name: Mezcal Bloody Mary
recipes.description: Mezcal Amores Verde, lime juice, salt, Tabasco, Salsa Valentina, Worcestershire Sauce and tomato juice.
sustainabilityTips: Tomato juice from sustainable sources

trainingSteps.title: Allergen note
trainingSteps.description: Contains GLUTEN and FISH from Worcestershire Sauce.

trainingSteps.title: Build
trainingSteps.description: Build in a highball glass over ice. Add all ingredients and stir well. Garnish with celery stick and lime wedge.

recipes.name: Mezcal Picante
recipes.description: Mezcal Amores Verde, lime juice, Triple Sec and chilli liqueur. Smoky and spicy.
sustainabilityTips: Chilli liqueur uses natural chilli extract

trainingSteps.title: Heat warning
trainingSteps.description: Always warn the guest about the heat level.

trainingSteps.title: Build
trainingSteps.description: Shake all ingredients with ice. Strain over ice. Tajin rim optional.

recipes.name: Mezcal Negroni
recipes.description: Mezcal Amores Verde, Campari and Vermouth. The smoky Mexican take on an Italian classic.
sustainabilityTips: Equal parts ratio minimises waste
Pre-batch for efficiency

trainingSteps.title: Equal parts
trainingSteps.description: 1:1:1 ratio. 30ml each. Never deviate.

trainingSteps.title: Stir over ice
trainingSteps.description: Stir in mixing glass for 30 seconds. Strain into rocks glass over a large ice cube.

trainingSteps.title: Orange peel
trainingSteps.description: Express an orange peel over the glass. Run around the rim.

trainingSteps.title: Education
trainingSteps.description: Many guests know the Negroni but may not have tried it with mezcal. Describe the smoky transformation.

recipes.name: Sacred Tamarind
recipes.description: Mezcal Amores Verde, Tamarind Syrup and lime juice. Smoky, sweet and sour in perfect balance.
sustainabilityTips: Tamarind is a traditional Mexican ingredient

trainingSteps.title: Three ingredients
trainingSteps.description: Perfectly balanced. Tamarind tangy and slightly sweet, mezcal smoky, lime juice bright.

trainingSteps.title: Shake hard
trainingSteps.description: Shake with ice. Strain over fresh ice in rocks glass. Tajin and tamarind candy garnish on the rim.

trainingSteps.title: Mexican story
trainingSteps.description: Tamarind is eaten as street food in Mexico with chilli, lime and salt. This cocktail captures that flavour memory.

recipes.name: Corona Extra
recipes.description: Mexican pale lager. Light and crisp. Served with a wedge of lime.
sustainabilityTips: Glass bottles are recyclable

trainingSteps.title: GLUTEN allergen
trainingSteps.description: Corona contains GLUTEN. Not suitable for coeliac guests.

trainingSteps.title: Serve correctly
trainingSteps.description: Always serve ice cold with a lime wedge pushed into the neck of the bottle.

trainingSteps.title: Beer cocktails
trainingSteps.description: Offer Michelada (+4.50), Chelada (+3.80) or Levantamuertos (+5.50) upgrades.

recipes.name: Modelo Especial
recipes.description: Full-flavoured Mexican lager with a hint of orange blossom honey and malt. Richer than Corona.
sustainabilityTips: Glass bottles are recyclable

trainingSteps.title: GLUTEN allergen
trainingSteps.description: Modelo contains GLUTEN.

trainingSteps.title: The difference
trainingSteps.description: Modelo is fuller in flavour than Corona with orange blossom and malt notes. Recommend for guests who want more character.

recipes.name: Pacifico Clara
recipes.description: Light Mexican lager from the Pacific coast. Crisp and refreshing.
sustainabilityTips: Glass bottles are recyclable

trainingSteps.title: GLUTEN allergen
trainingSteps.description: Pacifico contains GLUTEN.

trainingSteps.title: Serve
trainingSteps.description: Serve ice cold. Lime wedge on the side.

recipes.name: Michelada
recipes.description: Your choice of beer (extra charge) with lime juice, Maggi sauce, Worcestershire sauce and Valentina. Mexicos favourite beer cocktail.

trainingSteps.title: Price note
trainingSteps.description: The Michelada add-on is 4.50. Guest also pays for beer separately. Always clarify this.

trainingSteps.title: Build in glass
trainingSteps.description: Tajin and chilli salt rim. Ice. Add lime juice, Maggi, Worcestershire and Valentina. Pour beer slowly over top. Stir once.

trainingSteps.title: The Levantamuertos
trainingSteps.description: Levantamuertos (5.50) adds Clamato juice. Contains FISH AND SHELLFISH. Always warn guests with these allergies.

recipes.name: Chelada
recipes.description: Your choice of beer (extra charge) with lime juice. Clean and refreshing.

trainingSteps.title: Price note
trainingSteps.description: The Chelada add-on is 3.80. Guest also pays for beer separately.

trainingSteps.title: Build
trainingSteps.description: Squeeze of fresh lime juice into a cold beer glass. Pour beer over. Simple and refreshing.

recipes.name: Levantamuertos
recipes.description: Your choice of beer (extra charge) with lime juice, Maggi sauce, Worcestershire sauce, Clamato juice and Valentina. Contains traces of fish and shellfish.

trainingSteps.title: FISH AND SHELLFISH ALLERGEN
trainingSteps.description: Levantamuertos contains Clamato juice which contains fish and shellfish. Never serve to guests with these allergies.

trainingSteps.title: Price note
trainingSteps.description: Add-on 5.50 plus beer price.

trainingSteps.title: Build
trainingSteps.description: Same as Michelada but add 60ml Clamato juice.

recipes.name: Hibiscus Iced Tea
recipes.description: A layered drink with hibiscus syrup, lime juice, coconut water and agave. Beautiful, refreshing and completely alcohol free. Vegan and gluten free.
sustainabilityTips: Hibiscus flowers from ethical cooperatives in Mexico
No alcohol means no energy-intensive distillation

trainingSteps.title: Premium mocktail
trainingSteps.description: At 11.20 this is our premium non-alcoholic option. Present it with the same care as our cocktails.

trainingSteps.title: The layering
trainingSteps.description: Build carefully: coconut water and agave over ice first. Then slowly pour hibiscus syrup and lime down the side of the glass. Layers should be visible.

trainingSteps.title: Serve before stirring
trainingSteps.description: Let the guest see the layers before stirring. This is presentation value.

recipes.name: Aguas Frescas
recipes.description: Traditional Mexican sweet drink. Choose between Horchata, Tamarind or Hibiscus. Made in-house daily.
sustainabilityTips: All made in-house
Zero packaging waste
Traditional recipes support Mexican food heritage

trainingSteps.title: Three flavours
trainingSteps.description: Horchata (rice milk with cinnamon and vanilla - contains MILK), Tamarind (sweet and sour), Hibiscus (tart and floral). Ask which flavour.

trainingSteps.title: Serve over ice
trainingSteps.description: Large glass, lots of ice, generous pour.

trainingSteps.title: Great food pairing
trainingSteps.description: Ideal non-alcoholic pairing with spicy food. The sweetness cools the heat perfectly.

recipes.name: Jarritos
recipes.description: Authentic Mexican sodas! Flavours: Lime, Pineapple, Guava, Mandarin, Mexican Cola, Mango or Grapefruit.
sustainabilityTips: Glass bottles are fully recyclable

trainingSteps.title: The flavours
trainingSteps.description: Know all 7: Lime, Pineapple, Guava, Mandarin, Mexican Cola, Mango, Grapefruit. Know what is in stock.

trainingSteps.title: Mexican authenticity
trainingSteps.description: Genuine Mexican sodas made with natural fruit flavours. The story adds value.

trainingSteps.title: Serve in the bottle
trainingSteps.description: Always serve in the original glass bottle with a straw.

recipes.name: Espresso Martini
recipes.description: Shot of espresso, vodka and sugar. Served chilled in a coupe, straight up with a cinnamon sprinkle.
sustainabilityTips: Use Fairtrade espresso

trainingSteps.title: Fresh espresso only
trainingSteps.description: Freshly pulled espresso only. The crema creates the foam.

trainingSteps.title: Shake vigorously
trainingSteps.description: Shake harder than any other cocktail for 15-20 seconds.

trainingSteps.title: Cinnamon garnish
trainingSteps.description: Three coffee beans and a dusting of cinnamon. The cinnamon makes ours different.

recipes.name: Irish Coffee
recipes.description: Irish whiskey and coffee. Served hot. A classic after-dinner drink.
sustainabilityTips: Use Fairtrade coffee beans

trainingSteps.title: The classic
trainingSteps.description: Irish whiskey, hot coffee and sugar, topped with a layer of double cream. Served in a glass mug.

trainingSteps.title: The cream
trainingSteps.description: Pour cream slowly over the back of a spoon so it floats on top. The guest drinks the coffee through the cream.

trainingSteps.title: Serve hot
trainingSteps.description: Coffee must be very hot. Warm the glass first with hot water.

recipes.name: Carjillo
recipes.description: Hot espresso with Licor 43 liqueur. A Spanish classic that has become a beloved Mexican digestivo.
sustainabilityTips: Use Fairtrade espresso

trainingSteps.title: What is Carjillo
trainingSteps.description: Carjillo (car-HEE-yo) is a Mexican bar tradition. Licor 43 poured over espresso. Sweet vanilla liqueur and bitter coffee are a perfect match. A digestivo - suggest it after dessert.

trainingSteps.title: Serve correctly
trainingSteps.description: Pour Licor 43 into a small glass. Add freshly pulled espresso on top. Guest stirs to combine or drinks it layered.

trainingSteps.title: Upsell moment
trainingSteps.description: After dessert, always suggest a Carjillo or Mexican Cafe. High margin suggestion.

recipes.name: Mexican Cafe
recipes.description: Coffee tequila and espresso, shaken and served chilled. Our house version of the espresso martini.
sustainabilityTips: Use Fairtrade espresso
Cazcabel Coffee Tequila is made with Mexican coffee beans

trainingSteps.title: Build
trainingSteps.description: Shake Cazcabel Coffee Tequila and freshly pulled espresso with ice. Double fine strain into a chilled coupe. Coffee beans on top.

trainingSteps.title: The difference from Espresso Martini
trainingSteps.description: Mexican Cafe uses our house coffee tequila instead of vodka. More complex and lower ABV. At 11.20 it is also better value.
